identity: Lethariel keeps the oldest trees in the Accord, and someone with a forged bough-seal is counting them for the axe.

quests.title: The Debt Walks at Night
quests.text: At night, Debtbound Zombies shuffle through the {name:glades} {dir_of:lethariel:glades}, still trying to pay tolls nobody asked for. Lay six of them to rest. They burn at dawn, but the saplings they trample do not grow back by morning.

quests.title: Venison for the Star Hall
quests.text: Bring me five Raw Meat and one Braided Sinew from the Moss-Antler Stags that graze the {name:glades} {dir_of:lethariel:glades} by day. The stags are yellow and will not start a quarrel. The sinew ties my roasting bundles; the meat, well, you can guess.

quests.title: Tolls on a Public Glade
quests.text: Toll Bandits stop travellers in the {name:glades} after dark and charge them for walking on our grass. Defeat four of them; they come out only at night and in small numbers. Their toll slips bear a seal very like our bough-seal, which is why I am annoyed.

quests.title: Short Crates from Berrycourt
quests.text: Take this crate list to Ilwen Petalmeasure in Lorindor Berrycourt; the capital road leads out into Lorindor. Her berry deliveries have been short, and she blames the tolls. I blame the tolls for everything, but she has numbers.

quests.title: The Observatory Forgot to Eat
quests.text: Lethen Moonledger at the Moonfall Observatory has not collected his bread in a month, which for an astronomer means he forgot to eat. Take him word and see what keeps him from the road. The Moonfall Wood begins where Lethariel's trees grow darker.

quests.title: The Bough-Counter
quests.text: The forged bough-seal leads to the {name:poacher_camp} {dir_from_giver:poacher_camp}, where Unlicensed Poachers mark our oldest trees for felling. Defeat five of them, then {name:bough_counter_rusk}, who keeps the count. The camp is manned day and night; take the counter last, and alone.

quests.title: Roots Across the Border
quests.text: Rusk's count runs on into the Glassroot Wilds, where the Accord's writ grows thin. Take it to Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate; the road out of the capital leads into the contested wilds. You will want your full strength there, so finish your training first.

quests.title: Bounty: The Bakehouse Larder
quests.text: The bakehouse eats faster than I can fill it. Bring me eight Raw Meat whenever you return to Lethariel, and I will pay each time.
